android.desc:
🎹 Play free sheet music, learn piano, practice guitar tabs, and master music theory with interactive tools.

MuseScore is your all-in-one sheet music reader, music learning app, and practice platform for piano, guitar, violin, flute, and every instrument.

Access over 3 million FREE sheet music scores: piano sheet music, guitar tabs, chords, music notes, and full scores for solo, ensemble, band, or orchestra.

• Discover classical, pop, rock, jazz, anime, movie soundtracks, and game music
• Browse by instrument: piano, guitar, trumpet, violin, percussion, flute and more
• Save favorite scores and build your personal music library
• Download sheet music for offline practice with MuseScore PRO

🎼 Learn music with interactive sheet music

Improve note reading, rhythm, and performance skills using smart practice features:

• Interactive score player with high-quality sound
• Adjust tempo, loop sections, and practice bar-by-bar
• Built-in metronome to stay in time
• On-screen piano keyboard with note highlighting
• Transpose sheet music to any key
• Control instrument volume and visibility
• Auto-scroll to follow notes hands-free
• Export to PDF, MIDI, and MP3

🎓 Study music theory and take video courses

MuseScore LEARN gives you structured music education from professional teachers.

• Step-by-step piano lessons
• Guitar and violin courses
• Music theory, composition, and ear training
• Beginner to advanced levels
• Guided exercises and structured practice plans

Whether you want to read notes, practice chords, improve your instrument skills, use a metronome, tune your performance, or study music theory, MuseScore gives you sheet music, learning tools, and professional sound in one powerful music app.

From beginner piano players to advanced musicians, MuseScore helps you practice smarter, play better, and grow faster.
